title: Experimental investigation of thermal properties and fire behavior of carbon/epoxy laminate and its foam core sandwich composite
authors: Yanying Xu; Chao Lv; Ruiqing Shen; Zhi Wang; Qingsheng Wang
journal: Journal of Thermal Analysis and Calorimetry 136, 1237–1247
source_version: Published original, online 18 September 2018; issue year 2019
TGA_specimen_preparation: The source assays the manufactured laminate and complete foam-core sandwich composite under continuous nitrogen, 50 mL/min, room temperature to 1000 °C at 20 °C/min. Aliquot mass, pan, cutting or grinding, through-thickness sampling and TG conditioning are unreported.
LOI_method: FTT-OL-1402072 oxygen index instrument, England; ISO 4589-3; own measured oxygen index at room temperature and elevated temperatures
source_LOI_test_temperature_raw: room temperature, first point of the source temperature series; no numerical ambient temperature assigned
source_numeric_evidence_description: Exact numerical annotations printed on original publisher Figure 2 DTG curves and Figure 9 measured LOI points. Published author-uploaded main text supplies methods, preparation and physical interpretation. No curve coordinates estimated.
TG_locator: Figure 2 p 1239, printed peak annotations; thermal discussion pp 1239–1240; TG method p 1238
LOI_locator: Figure 9 p 1244, initial room-temperature labelled point; LOI method p 1239 and results p 1245
conditions_locator: Experimental materials p 1238, Tables 1/2 and Figure 1 p 1239; assay methods pp 1238–1239
source_location: Complete original published main text pp 1237–1247 through conclusion and references; public original publisher Figure 2 and Figure 9 pixels read directly, including labels and legends. Main PDF bytes unavailable.
washing_state: Initial manufactured laminate; no durability wash reported
treatment_chemistry: Commercial carbon/epoxy laminate architecture; no additional flame-retardant treatment reported
treatment_method: Manufactured by Liaoning General Aviation Research Institute, Shenyang, China. Araldite LY 1564SP epoxy and Hardener XB3487 were combined at a mass ratio of 100:34. The PAN-CF T300-3000 carbon/epoxy laminate was prepared by wet layup. The sandwich used carbon/epoxy laminate skins and a 4 mm closed-cell PVC foam core, Divinycell H60 4PSC supplied by DIAB, Sweden. The source supplies ply sequences but does not give the precise textile weave, fiber or matrix mass fraction, cure schedule, press or vacuum conditions, cooling history, sizing, or surface pretreatment.
source_peak_temperature_prose_qualifier: Thermal prose says close to 385 °C for laminate and close to 271/380 °C for sandwich; Figure 2 prints explicit integer peak labels.
limitations: Two initial manufactured structures are represented at the first, room-temperature LOI point. The publisher provides public Figure 2 and Figure 9 images with explicit numerical labels; these labels are transcribed directly, without extracting coordinates or calculating residue. The original main text is available as an indexed published author copy; main PDF bytes are unavailable. Figure 2 prints integer DTG peak temperatures, while the accompanying prose describes them as close to those temperatures; both source presentations are preserved. The source explicitly assays the finished laminate and foam-core sandwich composite. The exact textile weave and TG aliquot cutting, grinding, mass and through-thickness sampling are unreported. The source describes PAN-CF T300-3000 wet-layup plies, not a short-fiber-filled resin specimen. Cure, cooling, fiber fraction and conditioning are unreported. No numeric ambient temperature is inferred from the first LOI point position. The additional elevated-temperature LOI points are retained separately and are not additional preparation states. The three cone repetitions and five vertical/three horizontal burn repetitions are not assigned to TG or LOI. Stage intervals and stage mass losses are not T5 or an extrapolated onset. Table 3 and Figure 6 mass-retention values are from cone calorimetry, not TG; all canonical residues remain blank. Figure 2 rates have units percent per °C, which are not percent per minute. No wash, thermal aging or post-fire specimen is assigned to the initial pair. Related later carbon/epoxy sandwich work uses separate specimens and methods and requires its own observation-level review.
sample_state: Carbon/epoxy laminate; initial manufactured specimen; room-temperature LOI
composition: PAN-CF T300-3000 carbon plies and Araldite LY1564SP/Hardener XB3487 epoxy matrix at 100:34 resin/hardener mass ratio
source_material_form_TGA_raw: Carbon/epoxy laminate explicitly named in TG methods/results and Figure 2 legend
LOI_specimen_preparation: Source specimens cut to 150 × 10 mm and 1.78 mm thickness, tested from room temperature to 220 °C. This row uses the first room-temperature point; no durability wash reported.
pairing_evidence: Original Figure 2 explicitly labels the DTG peak(s) of Carbon/epoxy laminate; the source thermal discussion assigns the single maximum-rate peak to epoxy degradation. Figure 9 uses the same specimen name and shows first-point LOI 22.7. The methods identify this as the room-temperature start of the measured temperature series. No intermediate re-preparation is described.
